headline: 5 contracts/addresses catalogued on Monad; vault and strategy confirmed on-chain, deployer EOA and one Safe surfaced; no GitHub, audits, or official deployments doc found.

findings.text: MonadScan block-explorer search (via web_search) yielded no protocol name-tag for 'Valos'; vault contract 0x8d3F9f9Eb2f5E8B48EFBB4074440D1E2A34Bc365 found through tradingstrategy.ai and monadscan.com fetches with contract name AccountableAsyncRedeemVault, token symbol vUSD, created 192 days ago by EOA 0xb83986e9f33a6de4624b18da69cb474f6f94fc7c.
No official Valos deployed-contracts page found. Protocol.website field is blank; valos.io was referenced in monad.xyz blog but not directly fetchable in this run. deployed_contracts_doc set to null.
No audit links recorded in protocol.audit_links and none surfaced from any fetched source. MonadScan shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted' on the vault contract page.

No GitHub repo provided in protocol.github and none found in fetched sources. Accountable's open-source reference to src/vault/AccountableAsyncRedeemVault.sol visible in MonadScan verified source file list, but no Valos-specific repo surfaced.
Protocol.chains = [Monad] only; no multi-chain enumeration required. All discovered addresses are on Monad mainnet (chainId 143).

No factory pattern identified. The vault is a direct deployment (single AccountableAsyncRedeemVault). Strategy contract 0x8dCE15fc6a98484C995Fc702cBfBdA14A30454af is immutably referenced in vault bytecode and handles Borrow/Repay/SetLenders calls from deployer EOA.

Role taxonomy applied: vault=pool, strategy/lending contract=vault (Accountable VaaS), deployer EOA=admin/owner, Safe 0x87ef01f2...=multisig (Exec Transaction calls from deployer), AUSD=token, vault-factory-deployer 0xabCCE3f7=other.

All addresses in admin_addresses trace to fetched MonadScan and TradingStrategy URLs. Safe 0x87ef01f2f53de60c98a3337bc17dc75798526c05 surfaced from deployer EOA tx history (Exec Transaction calls); role tentative pending further reads. Factory/internal-tx deployer 0xabcce3f78a591c1c734cb16b6ea56dff3985953c surfaced from MonadScan internal tx on vault creation.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked MonadScan (Monad block explorer), TradingStrategy.ai vault page, Monad Foundation blog, and PR Newswire press release. 5 addresses catalogued: the primary vault contract, the Accountable strategy/lending contract, the deployer EOA, one probable Safe (Gnosis), and the AUSD denomination token. No GitHub repo, audit, or official deployments doc was found. grade=unknown per discovery-slice rules.

Valos announced Feb 17 2026 launch of institutional credit vault using Agora AUSD on Monad with $100M initial allocations; vault built on Accountable's Data Verification Network; Valos manages 50+ active loans; borrowers are market makers, prime brokers, exchanges, custodians.

protocol_metadata.about: Valos is a digital asset manager specializing in institutional private credit. Allocators deposit AUSD (Agora's institutional-grade stablecoin) into an ERC-7540 async redemption vault on Monad, and Valos deploys that capital as secured loans to institutional borrowers such as market makers, prime brokers, exchanges, and custodians. The vault is built on Accountable's Vault-as-a-Service infrastructure, which provides real-time on-chain verification of borrower solvency and loan health via a Data Verification Network, enabling continuous transparency instead of quarterly reporting. As of mid-2026 the vault holds approximately $110M TVL and targets $200M capacity, generating roughly 7–8% annualised yields denominated in AUSD.
